description: Welcome! My name is Nagy Ábel, and I'm a software developer. While that's a broad title, it best describes the variety of work I enjoy. Since 2020, I've worked on everything from games built with Unity to backend systems, business software, and websites using a variety of technologies. I enjoy solving problems, learning new technologies, and turning ideas into reliable, well-crafted software.
card_web_description: Modern, responsive websites and web applications built with the latest technologies.
card_game_description: Interactive 2D and 3D games using Unity, focusing on polished gameplay and engaging user experiences.
card_android_description: Native and cross-platform Android applications designed for performance, usability and scalability.
card_con_description: Technical guidance, architecture planning and problem solving to help turn your ideas into successful products.
portfolio_desc_car: A 3D car customization application where users can configure vehicles with different parts, colors and options.
portfolio_desc_block: A modern application focused on blockchain technology with a clean interface and efficient functionality.
portfolio_desc_bus: A custom system for tracking public transport, contains an android app, web interface, and admin panel.
portfolio_desc_scryper: A new type of boardgame developed using the Unity game engine.
portfolio_desc_fitness: A weight tracking web application. Developed using React for frontend and Laravel backend.
